```{r}

# Import libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(feasts)
library(skimr)
library(tseries)
```

## Data Loading and Initial Exploration

```{r}

# Import US energy consumption data from Github

raw_url <- "release_us_subnational_generation_monthly.csv"

gen_raw <- read_csv(raw_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

head(gen_raw, 20)
```

```{r}

# Cleaning & transformation

# Cleaning variable columns

gen <- gen_raw |>
  rename(
    area             = `Area`,
    iso3             = `ISO 3 code`,
    state            = `State`,
    state_code       = `State code`,
    date             = `Date`,
    source           = `Electricity source`,
    is_aggregate     = `Is aggregated source`,
    gen_twh          = `Generation (TWh)`,
    gen_yoy_twh      = `Generation YoY change (TWh)`,
    gen_yoy_pct      = `Generation YoY change (%)`,
    gen_share_pct    = `Share of generation (%)`,
    gen_share_yoy_pp = `Share of generation YoY change (% points)`,
    emis_mt          = `Emissions (MtCO2e)`,
    emis_yoy_mt      = `Emissions YoY change (MtCO2e)`,
    emis_yoy_pct     = `Emissions YoY change (%)`,
    emis_share_pct   = `Share of emissions (%)`,
    intensity_g_kwh  = `Emissions intensity (gCO2e/kWh)`
  ) |>
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date)) |>
    select(-area, -iso3)
```

```{r}

# View top 20 lines after column cleaning

skim(gen)
```

```{r}

# Rows like "Total generation", "Fossil", "Clean", "Renewables" are sums of other rows,
# and "US (total)" is the sum of all states. Keep them apart to avoid double counting.

# US monthly data 
gen_us  <- gen |> filter(state == "US (total)")

# Fossil and clean emissions
us_emissions <- gen_us |>
  filter(source %in% c("Fossil", "Clean")) |>
  select(month, source, emis_mt) |>
  arrange(source, month)
```

```{r}

# Data quality checks
## Duplicates, missing values 

# Duplicates
us_emissions |> count(source, month) |> filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}

# Missing values per column
gen |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
# Monthly tsibble
emissions_ts <- us_emissions |>
  as_tsibble(key = source, index = month)

# Series with missing months (clean vs. fossil)
has_gaps(emissions_ts)
```

```{r}

# Do fossil + clean emissions add up to total US emissions?
sumcheck <- us_emissions |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(groupedtotal = sum(emis_mt),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(gen_us |>
              filter(source == "Total generation") |>
              select(month, actualtotal = emis_mt),
    by = "month") |>
  mutate(difference = groupedtotal - actualtotal)

# Max. (absolute) difference between fossil + clean and actual total emissions
sumcheck |> summarise(max_difference_mt = max(abs(difference)))
```

```{r}

# Largest YoY % increases in monthly emissions
gen_us |>
  filter(source %in% c("Fossil", "Clean")) |>
  slice_max(emis_yoy_pct, n = 10) |>
  select(month, source, emis_mt, emis_yoy_pct)
```

```{r}

emissions_ts |>

  autoplot(emis_mt) + labs(title = "Monthly US Emissions (MtCO2e): Fossil Fuels",
                           subtitle = "January 2001 - August 2026",
                           x = "Month",
                           y = "Emissions (MtCO2e)")
```

```{r}

emissions_ts |>

                           subtitle = "January 2001 - August 2026",

```


```{r}

# Clean energy - monthly emissions intensity
gen_us |>
  filter(source == "Clean") |>
  as_tsibble(key = source, index = month) |>
  autoplot(intensity_g_kwh) + labs(title = "Monthly US Emissions Intensity: Clean Energy",

```

```{r}

# US share of energy consumption by source - clean, renewable, fossil fuel
# Includes grouping sources

gen_us_grouped <- gen_us |> 
  filter(is_aggregate,
         source %in% c("Fossil", "Clean")) |>
  arrange(source, month)
  

gen_us_grouped |> as_tsibble(key = source, index = month) |>
  autoplot(emis_share_pct) + labs(title = "US Share of Emissions by Source Group",
                                  subtitle = "January 2001 - August 2026",
                                  x = "Month",
                                  y = "Share of total emissions (%)",
                                  colour = "Source")
```

```{r}

# Heatmap of grouped US data

gen_us_grouped |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(month), y = source, fill = emis_share_pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Emissions share (%)") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years",
               date_labels = "%Y",
               expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Monthly US Share of Emissions by Source Group (%)", x = NULL, y = NULL) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}

# Check for correlations between fossil and clean

correlations <- us_emissions |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = source,
              values_from = emis_mt)

correlations |>
  select(Fossil, Clean) |>
  cor(use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}

# Choose target series (fossil and clean)

fossil <- emissions_ts |> filter(source == "Fossil")

clean <- emissions_ts |> filter(source == "Clean")
```

```{r}

# STL decomposition - fossil fuels
fossil |> model(STL(emis_mt)) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}

# STL decomposition - clean energy
clean |> model(STL(emis_mt)) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}

# Identifying stationarity and recommended seasonal differencing

# Unit root tests
emissions_ts |>
  features(emis_mt, list(unitroot_kpss, unitroot_nsdiffs))

# Checking for recommended ordinary differencing, on the two seasonally differenced series
emissions_ts |>
  group_by(source) |>
  mutate(seasonal_diff = difference(emis_mt, 12)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(seasonal_diff)) |>
  features(seasonal_diff, unitroot_ndiffs)
```

```{r}

# Differencing

# Clean - seasonal difference + ordinary difference
clean <- clean |>
  mutate(emis_diff = difference(difference(emis_mt, lag = 12), lag = 1))

# Fossil - only seasonal difference
fossil <- fossil |>
  mutate(emis_diff = difference(emis_mt, lag = 12))
```

```{r}

# Re-checking stationarity
clean |> filter(!is.na(emis_diff)) |> features(emis_diff, unitroot_kpss)
fossil |> filter(!is.na(emis_diff)) |> features(emis_diff, unitroot_kpss)
```

```{r}

# Differenced series, ACF & PACF values of differenced series

clean |>
  filter(!is.na(emis_diff)) |>
  gg_tsdisplay(emis_diff, plot_type = "partial", lag_max = 36) +
  labs(title = "Clean Energy Emissions - Post-Seasonal + Ordinary Differencing")

fossil |>
  filter(!is.na(emis_diff)) |>
  gg_tsdisplay(emis_diff, plot_type = "partial", lag_max = 36) +
  labs(title = "Fossil Fuel Emissions - Post-Seasonal Differencing")
```

```{r}

# Exploring log transformations

# Fossil fuel emissions - log scale plot
fossil |>
  autoplot(log(emis_mt)) +
  labs(title = "Monthly US Fossil Fuel Emissions: Log Scale",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Log Emissions")

# Clean energy emissions - log scale plot
clean |>
  autoplot(log(emis_mt)) +
  labs(title = "Monthly US Clean Energy Emissions: Log Scale",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Log Emissions")
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
